meta.direction: Verdict Log: a calm terminal at night
meta.note: Colours and type from the owner's brief (dark values exact; light values derived for contrast). Voice and real copy from the repository README and docs.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, terminal panes, table bodies, the nav bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised strips inside a surface: terminal title bars, table header rows, inline code, hover rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the outline of surfaces. Decorative only: never the only thing that marks a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines that identify a control (secondary button, inputs). At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy and code on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, step numbers, pending steps, code comments, footer. Reads on bg, surface and surface-2 at 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber cursor. A FILL only: the primary button, the blinking cursor block, the running-step marker. One accent element per screen. Never text on light grounds (1.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Amber as text or a thin mark: link hover underline, the focus ring, a running step's label. Counts toward the one-accent budget.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (10.8:1).

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: PASS only: the verdict pill fill, the word PASS, passed-step marks. Never decoration, never a generic success or brand colour.

tokens.name: on-pass
tokens.usage: The word PASS on a pass fill.

tokens.name: pass-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet ground behind a passed ledger row or PR summary header. Text on it stays text; the word PASS on it uses pass.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: FAIL only: the verdict pill fill, the word FAIL, failed-step marks, the danger callout. Never for emphasis or errors that are not a verdict, except the danger callout.

tokens.name: on-fail
tokens.usage: The word FAIL on a fail fill.

tokens.name: fail-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet ground behind a failed ledger row, PR summary header or danger callout.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 5:1 or more on bg and surface.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: A QA engineer for your coding agent
styles.usage: One line of hero copy per layout (social cards, README hero). text colour.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Why you can trust the verdict

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Ask your agent to QA a change. It writes a plan; QaReN runs it and reports PASS or FAIL.
styles.usage: First paragraph of a page or hero, in muted or text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every run ends in PASS, FAIL or a refusal with a typed reason.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Each run keeps a step-by-step ledger and a readable report.
styles.usage: Card body, table cells, callout body.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, always the exact casing QaReN, in text colour, optionally followed by the accent cursor block. Scale freely; keep weight 600.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: The words PASS and FAIL in a verdict pill. The only all-caps text in the system.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers, badges, table headers, metadata, durations. Sentence case.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, terminal panes, inline code (inline at 0.9em of its line).

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Ledger rows, PR summary details, dense terminal output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pill inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline padding of badges and inline code; gap between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (md), table cell padding, step list row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and code block padding, nav bar inline padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; callout padding; section gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections on small screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding and social-card margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, badges, the cursor block.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, callouts, table outline.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, terminal panes, the video proof card, PR summary block.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The verdict pill only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider (border or border-strong colour).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, in focus colour.

tokens.name: border-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare: the system separates by surface and hairline first.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Terminal panes and the video proof card when they float over a layout (heroes, social cards).

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default for cards, code blocks and tables inside docs.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Step status changes, callout and row reveal.

tokens.name: duration-cursor
tokens.usage: One full blink of the cursor block (steps, never a fade).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Everything that moves or changes colour.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving the screen.
